title: Jonah
textBlocks:
Today we will hear that how 
Jonah 
TRIED TO RUN AWAY FROM GOD

WE MUST LISTEN TO GOD

God has a job for us. 
Just like He had a job for Jonah. 
But Jonah was too scared - he was full of fear and decided NOT to listen to God.
God told him to go and warn a city called Nineveh.
But Jonah got on a boat instead and sailed in the opposite direction to Tarsus.
You will hear how the Lord followed him and sent a BIG STORM to stop Jonah and bring him back!

Dear Lord 
We want to listen to you and to follow you.

Matthew 12:40
For as Jonah was in the belly of the great fish for three days and three nights….
